articles.title: Is Fortnite Down? Epic Games confirms major outage also hitting Rocket League and Fall Guys
articles.description: Fortnite faced log-in issues on Thursday evening. Many players could not access the game. Epic Games acknowledged the problem. Rocket League and Fall Guys were also affected. The company is working to fix the issue. Players expressed their frustration online. The cause of the outage is unknown. Epic Games has not given a timeline for resolution.
